description: This file defines the delete operation for articles in the Conduit application, including command validation and the handler to delete an article by slug.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler for deleting an article.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Validates that the slug is not null or empty.

methods.name: QueryHandler
methods.description: Handles the deletion of the article identified by slug from the database.
